title: PubPascal package manifest
description: pubpascal.json — PubPascal's own package manifest (independent of boss.json).

kind.description: Decides what 'install' does. runtime=add search paths (the library you use in code); designtime=also build+register the design-time BPL (IDE only); installer=download+run the vendor's installer (the install descriptor).

sources.description: Unit folders relative to the repo root; added to DCC_UnitSearchPath.

compilers.description: Supported RAD Studio compiler versions, e.g. '13.0'.

dependencies.description: Map of '<owner>/<repo>' to a version range.

install.description: Required when kind is 'installer'. The vendor installer PubPascal downloads + runs.

url.description: Download URL. For paid packages the portal serves the authorized, license-gated URL.

silentArgs.description: Args for an unattended install, e.g. '/VERYSILENT'.

interactive.description: Run the installer's GUI instead of silent.

sha256.description: Expected file hash (integrity check before running).

signedBy.description: Expected Authenticode signer (trust check before running).
